label: In a universal three-world frame with four rigid individuals and populations {a,b,c}, {b,c,d}…
meaning: In a universal three-world frame with four rigid individuals and populations {a,b,c}, {b,c,d}, {b}, absence amalgamation holds for every ordered accessible pair, while exact meet closure fails: the first two populations have intersection {b,c}, which none of the three populations realizes. This is a mathematical countermodel to the converse, not a metaphysical possibility claim.
